title: Counting sort count-array shift
statement: Let $	ext{Idx}$ and $	ext{Cnt}$ be program variables, let $	ext{Buckets}$ denote the bucket count, and let $M(a)$ denote the value read from memory address $a$. The program sets $	ext{Idx}$ to $	ext{Buckets}$; while $	ext{Idx}>0$, it copies the value at address $	ext{Cnt}+	ext{Idx}-1$ to address $	ext{Cnt}+	ext{Idx}$ and decrements $	ext{Idx}$; then it writes $0$ to address $	ext{Cnt}$.
